comboData.title: Alien FTK: Premature Burial Loop into Machu Mech and Dark Strike Fighter
comboData.description: A three-card first-turn kill. Cosmic Fortress Gol'gar returns your face-up Spells to your hand and places an A-Counter for each one, so Premature Burial revives Gol'gar over and over while Code A Ancient Ruins spends the counters to bring Alien Ammonite back. Each revival opens a new Synchro or Link Summon: Nothung burns 800, Worldsea Dragon Zealantis resets every monster, and Geonator Transverser gives your opponent Ancient Sacred Wyvern. The 7200 LP you spend on Burials pumps that Wyvern to 8500 ATK under their control, and Number 33: Chronomaly Machu Mech burns them for the 6400 difference. Dark Strike Fighter Tributes itself for the last 1400. Your opponent never gets a turn. Starting hand: Alien Ammonite + Unexpected Dai + Premature Burial. Deck: Alien Shocktrooper, Code A Ancient Ruins, Black Garden. Extra Deck: Gol'gar, M-Frame, Zer'oll, Nothung, Ancient Sacred Wyvern, Zealantis, Garden Rose Maiden, Geonator Transverser, Saryuja Skull Dread, Muddy Mudragon, Dark Strike Fighter, Machu Mech. A hand trap that stops Gol'gar or Premature Burial ends the loop, and you finish on 800 LP.

comboData.title: Theorealized Medius: Nerva, Diactorus and an Impasto Hand-off
comboData.description: Going first with an Artmage build. Artmage Power Patron is the Power Patron card that lets Theorealized Medius Special Summon itself from the hand, and the Theorealize Liberation it adds calls Nervedo for Nerva. You pass with Nerva, Artmage Diactorus, Artmage Graflare and Theorealized Medius (Illusion, Fairy and Dragon: three Monster Types) plus a set Artmage Impasto -Recapture-. On your opponent's turn, Impasto banishes Artmage Diactorus face-up until the End Phase. That banish triggers Theorealized Medius, which brings out a second Artmage Diactorus while the first is away. Starting hand: Medius the Pure + Theorealized Medius. Extra Deck: Nerva the Power Patron of Creation and 2 Artmage Diactorus.

comboData.title: Theorealized Medius: Theorealize, a Self-Banish and Past Lull
comboData.description: A Medius build with two copies of Theorealized Medius and no Artmage cards in the Main Deck. Medius the Pure calls one copy from the Deck, and that copy is the Power Patron card the one in your hand needs. Theorealize sends a second Medius the Pure to the GY. That copy revives itself and is banished when it leaves the field, and the face-up banish triggers Theorealized Medius. The same Link Summon puts the other copy in the GY, which is what Purification Power Patron's search needs. You end on Purification Power Patron, Artmage Diactorus and a Medius the Pure your opponent couldn't respond to. Starting hand: Medius the Pure + Theorealized Medius.

steps.text: Activate effect: Medius the Pure was Normal Summoned.

Send the Theorealized Medius that came from the Deck to the GY as material.

In the same chain, activate effect: the Theorealized Medius still on the field. Medius the Pure was just banished face-up.

Theorealize Past Lull goes to the GY.

comboData.title: Black Whirlwind Chain into a Six-Monster Synchro Board
comboData.description: A Black Whirlwind-powered opening that chains Simoon the Poison Wind, Sudri the Phantom Glimmer, and Vata the Emblem of Wandering into a repeating Synchro engine. Nothung the Starlight and Boreastorm the Wicked Wind are Synchro Summoned and sent back to the Graveyard in sequence, using Black Feather Whirlwind and Zephyros the Elite to keep re-fueling the Whirlwind loop and pump out three separate copies of Black-Winged Assault Dragon. The line closes with Blackwing Full Armor Master, a second Black-Winged Dragon, and a second Nothung the Starlight rounding out a six-monster board, backed by Twin Shadow and Black Shadow Squall set in the Spell/Trap Zone. Heads-up: this line uses Crossout Designator, which is Forbidden in the TCG, so it isn't legal at TCG events as shown.

comboData.title: Simoon and Sudri Double Summon into Bystial Dis Pater
comboData.description: A Black Whirlwind opening that converts Simoon the Poison Wind and Sudri the Phantom Glimmer into two Normal Summons in the same turn. Simoon banishes Harmattan the Dust from hand to summon itself, Whirlwind searches off every summon, and Shamal the Sandstorm banishes itself to bring out Vata the Emblem of Wandering, which mills Chinook the Snow Blast and Zephyros the Elite for Black-Winged Dragon. Zephyros bounces Sudri back to hand to reuse it, Black-Winged Dragon is recycled into Bystial Dis Pater, and Black Feather Whirlwind revives Zephyros and Sharnga the Waning Moon to Synchro Summon Blackwing - Nothung the Starlight. The board finishes with Dis Pater, Nothung, a re-summoned Sudri and Blackwing - Twin Shadow active in the backrow.

comboData.title: Dark Time Wizard: Going Second, Called Right
comboData.description: Going second into a board with monsters and Set Traps. Sleepy Scapegoats brings Tokens and Swiftwind Panther Warrior, Panther Tributes a Token for Jinzo - Energy Shocker, which destroys your opponent's Traps while its lock stops them chaining new ones. Alligator's Dragon Knight adds Graceful & Skull Dice and Foolish Graverobber. Then Dark Time Wizard's coin toss. This line is the right call: your opponent's monsters are destroyed and they take half their original ATK as damage, and the open Exceed procedure adds a 3400-ATK attacker. Exceed, Jinzo, Panther and the Dragon Knight swing for 9,500 before Graceful & Skull Dice adds at least 400 more to each. Exceed's own summon effect needs a Level 8 or lower monster in your hand or Graveyard, and this line has none, so skip it unless you drew one. Starting hand: Sleepy Scapegoats + Dark Time Wizard + Alligator's Dragon Knight. Your Normal Summon stays unused.

comboData.title: Endymion Full Combo Line (Advanced)
comboData.description: Advanced full combo line weaving together the Magistus, Spellbook, Witchcrafter, Sky Striker, and Mythical Beast engines. Not recommended for beginners — requires precise sequencing across 200+ steps. This is a specific draw loop variant of the deck, distinct from the standard Endymion line (which ends on multiple negates via Servant → Electrumite → Selene). The core of the draw loop: Royal Magical Library accumulates spell counters from each spell activation and cashes them in for free draws, while Wonder Wand draws 2 by sending itself and its equipped monster to the GY, and Pot of Avarice recycles monsters back into the deck for another two draws — each cycle fuelling the next until you have enough resources to establish the full end board with multiple Endymion bounce negates and set backrow.

comboData.title: Gorgonic Umbral Horror: Going First into C104 Victory
comboData.description: The Beyond the Brave core from the one Gorgonic that is Level 4. All five new cards appear: Gorgonic, V, Thousand and Shining Umbral Horror build two Number 104: Masquerade V, and V Umbral Horror ranks the first one up into Number C104: Umbral Horror Masquerade Victory from the Graveyard, with no Rank-Up-Magic Spell. Gorgonic counts as 2 of Masquerade V's 3 materials, and Shining does the same for the second copy. Nibiru is live once Thousand returns, the fifth summon. Starting hand: Gorgonic Umbral Horror + 1 card to discard (a spare Barian's Seal is best).

cards.name: Number C104: Umbral Horror Masquerade Victory

steps.text: Activate effect: Gorgonic Umbral Horror in your hand. You control no monsters, so it can summon itself.
Special Summon Gorgonic Umbral Horror. While it is face-up, the only monsters you can Special Summon from the Extra Deck are Number Xyz Monsters.
Add V Umbral Horror from your Deck to your hand. Gorgonic can only add a non-Rock Umbral Horror, and V is a Spellcaster.
Activate effect: V Umbral Horror was Normal Summoned.
Add Thousand Umbral Horror from your Deck to your hand.
Activate effect: Thousand Umbral Horror in your hand, as a Quick Effect.
Send Thousand Umbral Horror to the Graveyard as the cost.

Place Barian's Seventh Untopia from your Deck face-up in your Field Zone. It is placed, not activated, so nothing that negates a Spell's activation can answer it. Until the end of your next turn, Xyz Monsters are the only monsters you can bring out of your Extra Deck.
Activate effect: Barian's Seventh Untopia in your Field Zone.
Add Shining Umbral Horror from your Deck to your hand.
Discard Barian's Seal. On a later turn it can banish itself from the Graveyard to bring back 2 Umbral Horror monsters.
Xyz Summon Number 104: Masquerade V. It is a Number, so Gorgonic's restriction allows it.
Gorgonic Umbral Horror becomes material for Masquerade V. It counts as 2 of the 3 materials.
V Umbral Horror becomes the third material.
Activate effect: Shining Umbral Horror in your hand, because you brought out a Masquerade Xyz Monster.
Special Summon Shining Umbral Horror and draw 1 card. If you draw an Umbral Horror monster, you can Special Summon it too.
Activate effect: Thousand Umbral Horror in your Graveyard, because an Xyz Monster came out. It chains with Shining, since both respond to Masquerade V.
Special Summon Thousand Umbral Horror. For the rest of this turn, your own card effects deal you no damage.
Detach V Umbral Horror as the cost.
Add Barian's Seal from your Deck to your hand.
Activate effect: V Umbral Horror in your Graveyard. Banish it and target Masquerade V.
Special Summon Number C104: Umbral Horror Masquerade Victory from your Extra Deck with Masquerade V as its material. This is treated as an Xyz Summon.
Masquerade V becomes material for C104 Victory.
Gorgonic Umbral Horror transfers along with Masquerade V. It is now material, not a face-up monster, so its Number-only restriction has stopped.

Activate effect: C104 Victory gained Masquerade V's effect, because Masquerade V was on the field when it became material. Your opponent either banishes 4 monsters with different Attributes and 1 Spell from their Deck, or you banish the top 10 cards of their Deck.
Xyz Summon a second Number 104: Masquerade V.
Shining Umbral Horror becomes material. It counts as 2 of the 3 materials, just like Gorgonic.
Thousand Umbral Horror becomes the third material.
Activate effect: the second Masquerade V. Its detach effect is once per turn for each copy, not once per name.
Detach Thousand Umbral Horror as the cost. From the Graveyard it can return again on a later turn, whenever any Xyz Monster comes out.
Add Barian's Hope from your Deck to your hand. Next turn it brings back an Umbral Horror or a Masquerade Xyz Monster from your hand or Graveyard.
Set Barian's Seal. You control a Number C104, so it can negate your opponent's first card or effect next turn, then attach a monster to one of your Xyz Monsters.

End Phase: Barian's Seventh Untopia deals 400 damage per Xyz Monster on the field to each player. That is 800 to your opponent and none to you, because of Thousand. End board: C104 Victory (2 materials, a Quick Effect that destroys a card), Masquerade V (1 material), Untopia, a Set Barian's Seal, and Barian's Hope plus Shining's draw in hand.

comboData.title: Endymion Magistus into the Full Fairy Tail Package
comboData.description: A hybrid line that builds the Magistus core off Spell Power Mastery before pivoting into a complete Fairy Tail package. Spell Power Mastery opens Regulus, the Prince of Endymion, which lands Endymion Empire and Verre, the Maid of Endymion; Verre Magic - Lacrima of Light and Witchcrafter Genni fuel Zoroa, the Magistus of Flame. Artemis, the Magistus Moon Maiden becomes Borreload Savage Dragon, then Spenta and Endymion, the Crescent Magistus feed Magistus Chorozo, Summon Sorceress and Akashic Magician, closing the Magistus half on Zoroa, the Magistus Verethragna. From there Fairy Tail - Luna and Matchgiru make Fairy Tail - Wiccat under Fairy Tail Ball, loading Once Upon a Fairy Tail and Tails of the Fairy Tails for Teller of Fairy Tails, a revived Fairy Tail - Snow and a second Wiccat, with Snow banishing the spent Magistus pieces to reset Once Upon a Fairy Tail. Heads-up: this line uses Borreload Savage Dragon, which is Forbidden in the TCG (as of 5 October 2026), so it isn't legal at TCG events as shown.

comboData.title: Twin Dragon Loop into Herald of Mirage Lights
comboData.description:
Continuing the Angwitch opening: Mace revives itself from the Graveyard, mills again, and fuels a second Mementotlan Fusion — bringing back Mementomictlan Tecuhtlica – Creation King straight out of the GY.

Tecuhtlica's on-summon mill revives Ghattic (who retrieves Shleepy) and banishes itself to activate the Mementomictlan field spell. Shleepy then special summons itself and fuels a second Fusion into Mementotlan Twin Dragon.

Twin Dragon's own Graveyard trigger sets the field spell off a second time, reviving Goblin, Akihiron, and Shleepy and chaining through a banished Fusion and Goblin's revival effects.

The line closes by Link Summoning Herald of Mirage Lights, reviving Mementotlan-Horned Dragon and Mementoal Tecuhtlica – Combined Creation from the Graveyard, and setting Bone Party, Fusion, and Cranium Burst as backrow for next turn.

comboData.title: Memento into Fiendsmith Splash — Necroquip Princess, Ptolemy M7 & Double Desirae
comboData.description:
Same Angwitch-into-Twin Dragon Memento core, splashed into a full Fiendsmith package. After the Mementomictlan field spell revives Goblin, Akihiron, and Shleepy, Link Summon Moon of the Closed Heaven into Fiendsmith's Requiem, then tribute Requiem to Special Summon Lacrima the Crimson Tears and mill a Fiendsmith Engraver.

Requiem's Graveyard effect fuels a Fusion Summon of Necroquip Princess. The Engraver chain keeps going into an Xyz Summon of Constellar Ptolemy M7, a Fiendsmith's Tract that searches Fabled Lurrie, and a Link Summon of Fiendsmith's Sequence that Fusion Summons Fiendsmith's Desirae.

Sequence and Desirae are sent together to Link Summon Cross-Sheep alongside a revived Mementoal Tecuhtlica – Combined Creation. Cross-Sheep chains into Lacrima once more to Link Summon A Bao A Qu, the Lightless Shadow.

A Bao A Qu mills Bone Party and banishes itself to Fusion Summon a second Fiendsmith's Desirae. The turn ends with Fusion and Cranium Burst set, plus an active Mementomictlan field spell, for a commanding board-and-backrow presence. Heads-up: this line uses Moon of the Closed Heaven, which is Forbidden in the TCG (as of 5 October 2026), so it isn't legal at TCG events as shown.

comboData.description: The Angwitch opening taken into a K9 package. Angwitch searches Mementotlan Tatsunootoshigo, which mills Shleepy, Goblin and Mace; Mace revives itself for Mementotlan Fusion into Mementomictlan Tecuhtlica - Creation King, whose mill sets up Ghattic and whose banish adds the Mementomictlan field spell. comboData.title: Masquerade V Rank-Up Chain: Gorgonic to Chaos Barian Dragon
comboData.description: Going first from Gorgonic Umbral Horror alone. Number 104: Masquerade V needs three Level 4 monsters, but Gorgonic counts as two of them. From there the line climbs Rank 4 to Rank 5 to Rank 7 without a Rank-Up-Magic Spell. Every step is an Xyz Summon that keeps its materials, and C104 Victory picks up Masquerade V's banish effect on the way. Nibiru is live once C104 Victory lands, since it is the fifth summon. The Barian's guide covers the longer Barian's Seventh Untopia version. Starting hand: Gorgonic Umbral Horror.

comboData.title: Seventh Tachyon Reveal: Masquerade V into C104 Victory (Going Second)
comboData.description: Going second in a Number deck that already runs Seventh Tachyon. Masquerade V has the same Rank 4 LIGHT Spellcaster profile as the 2013 Masquerade, so revealing it can add V Umbral Horror, Shining Umbral Horror, or the deck's own LIGHT Level 4s such as Utopic Onomatopoeia, ZS - Ascended Sage and Astraltopia. Shining's draw gets back the card Tachyon put on top of your Deck. C104 Victory breaks one card with its Quick Effect and wins its battle. Barian's Hope then brings Gorgonic back for a second Masquerade V, which adds Barian's Seal for the following turn. Starting hand: Seventh Tachyon + Utopic Onomatopoeia.

comboData.title: Mediclius: Going-Second 9000 ATK Breaker
comboData.description: Going second into a set-up board. Medius the Pure and Purification Power Patron put Mediclius the Extraordinary Power Patron in the Extra Monster Zone. Only then do you banish the Finite and the Infinite from your hand, so the tripled ATK has a Power Patron Link Monster to apply to. comboData.title: Daredevil: Two-Card Triantis Backrow Break
comboData.description: Going second into a boss that can't be targeted, a second monster and two Set cards. Ophrys Scorpio and Byblisp find Bufolicula and Triantis. Triantis places Predator Counters by choosing, not targeting, so the boss's protection doesn't stop them. Daredevil then Tributes the boss as part of its own summon, which starts no chain, and destroys both Set cards. Drosophyllum Hydra Tributes the second monster. Starting hand: Predaplant Ophrys Scorpio + Predaplant Byblisp. Extra Deck: Predaplant Ambulomelides and Predaplant Daredevil. Watch for Ash Blossom on Scorpio and on the three adds, and for Nibiru once Daredevil, your fifth summon, is on the field. A monster that is unaffected by card effects can't get a Predator Counter at all.

comboData.title: Daredevil: Predaplanning Ambush With Super Polymerization
comboData.description: Your opponent's turn. From turn 1 you kept Predaplant Dragostapelia and Predaplant Longinephila on the field, with Predaplanning and Super Polymerization Set and 1 card in hand. Your opponent summons a boss and a second monster and Sets two cards. In their Main Phase, Predaplanning puts a Predator Counter on every face-up monster, and Dragostapelia now negates the activated effects of both of theirs. Super Polymerization turns their boss and Longinephila into Daredevil, and neither player can respond to it. Predaplanning's GY effect and Daredevil's Quick Effect then clear the other three cards on their own turn. Daredevil's effect needs a Main Phase, so don't wait for the Battle Phase to activate Super Polymerization.

comboData.title: Havnis Extension through Herald of Orange Light
comboData.description: A prime example of Tearlaments' resilience to disruption. The opening Normal Summon of Tearlaments Reinoheart is met with the opponent's Infinite Impermanence, so the line plays out on their turn: Herald of Orange Light negates their Pumpking the King of Grave Ghosts, and Tearlaments Havnis Special Summons itself from the hand during their Main Phase. The resulting mills hit Tearlaments Merrli and Tearlaments Sulliek, netting a search for Tearlaments Scheiren and a Fusion Summon of Tearlaments Kitkallos, which extends into Tearlaments Rulkallos; Keldo the Sacred Protector then shuffles three of the opponent's Graveyard cards back into their Deck. Heads-up: this line uses Tearlaments Kitkallos and Agido the Ancient Sentinel, which are Forbidden in the TCG (as of 5 October 2026), so it isn't legal at TCG events as shown.

comboData.title: Cartoon Shade: Sorcerer of the Swamp into Horned Saurus
comboData.description: Two cards, going first or second. Sorcerer of the Swamp turns into Horned Saurus through Kaitoptera and Polymerization. Horned Saurus places Toon Kingdom from the Deck without activating it, so nothing is banished from the Deck, and as an Extra Deck monster it can't be Normal Summoned, which lets Cartoon Shade come out. Shade adds Toon Dark Magician Girl and is her Tribute. Going second, the bounce clears 2 cards and Horned Saurus and Toon Dark Magician Girl attack directly for 4000. Starting hand: Sorcerer of the Swamp, Cartoon Shade.

comboData.title: The K9 Full Combo — Triple Gustav Max
comboData.description: An ambitious combo starting with K9-04 Noroi's Normal Summon, which searches and special summons K9-66a Jokul for an immediate Xyz Summon into K9-17 "Ripper". The line chains through K9-66b Lantern, Infinitrack River Stormer, Heavy Freight Train Derricrane, Revolving Switchyard, Flying Pegasus Railroad Stampede, and the Infinitrack engine to build toward a three-copy Superdreadnought Rail Cannon Gustav Max endboard supported by Clockwork Knight. comboData.title: Atlantis: Warchief + Siren Vortex into Neo-Daedalus Rage
comboData.description: Going first with two Beyond the Brave cards. Warchief of Atlantis finds Advent of Atlantis, Advent places Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon, and Warchief comes back because Advent is named "Umi" on the field. Siren Vortex of Atlantis and Advent's Graveyard search bring out Levia-Dragon of Atlantis - Daedalus. With Atlantis in the Field Zone, Levia-Dragoon - Daedalus needs only 2 materials and Azure Ocean Dragon Lord - Neo-Daedalus Rage only 3. Rage then brings Levia-Dragoon back from the Graveyard, so both of their Quick Effects are ready for your opponent's turn. Starting hand: Warchief of Atlantis + Siren Vortex of Atlantis.

comboData.title: Alien FTK: Premature Burial Loop into Machu Mech and Dark Strike Fighter
comboData.description: A three-card first-turn kill. Cosmic Fortress Gol'gar returns your face-up Spells to your hand and places an A-Counter for each one, so Premature Burial revives Gol'gar over and over while Code A Ancient Ruins spends the counters to bring Alien Ammonite back. Each revival opens a new Synchro or Link Summon: Nothung burns 800, Worldsea Dragon Zealantis resets every monster, and Geonator Transverser gives your opponent Ancient Sacred Wyvern. The 7200 LP you spend on Burials pumps that Wyvern to 8500 ATK under their control, and Number 33: Chronomaly Machu Mech burns them for the 6400 difference. Dark Strike Fighter Tributes itself for the last 1400. Your opponent never gets a turn. Starting hand: Alien Ammonite + Unexpected Dai + Premature Burial. Deck: Alien Shocktrooper, Code A Ancient Ruins, Black Garden. Extra Deck: Gol'gar, M-Frame, Zer'oll, Nothung, Ancient Sacred Wyvern, Zealantis, Garden Rose Maiden, Geonator Transverser, Saryuja Skull Dread, Muddy Mudragon, Dark Strike Fighter, Machu Mech. A hand trap that stops Gol'gar or Premature Burial ends the loop, and you finish on 800 LP.

comboData.title: Black Whirlwind Chain into a Six-Monster Synchro Board
comboData.description: A Black Whirlwind-powered opening that chains Simoon the Poison Wind, Sudri the Phantom Glimmer, and Vata the Emblem of Wandering into a repeating Synchro engine. Nothung the Starlight and Boreastorm the Wicked Wind are Synchro Summoned and sent back to the Graveyard in sequence, using Black Feather Whirlwind and Zephyros the Elite to keep re-fueling the Whirlwind loop and pump out three separate copies of Black-Winged Assault Dragon. The line closes with Blackwing Full Armor Master, a second Black-Winged Dragon, and a second Nothung the Starlight rounding out a six-monster board, backed by Twin Shadow and Black Shadow Squall set in the Spell/Trap Zone. Heads-up: this line uses Crossout Designator, which is Forbidden in the TCG, so it isn't legal at TCG events as shown.

comboData.title: Pumpking's Eldlich Splash into The Undying Legion
comboData.description:
A one-card Pumpking opening that snowballs into the deck's full Eldlich package. Pumpking discards itself as the reveal cost to Set Call of the Haunted, then the Trap revives it immediately, netting Changshi the Spiridao from the Deck and milling Army of the Haunted and Eldlich the Golden Lord along the way.

Overlaying Pumpking and Changshi into Officiator of Doom Samuel restocks Changshi from the Graveyard, which lets Army of the Haunted Special Summon itself off its own trigger — fueling a Rank-Up into Pumpking the Great Ghost King. Ghost King's on-field effects mill Stare of the Snake Hair and bounce Delta of Invitation back to hand.

Eldlich the Golden Lord revives itself by sending a Call of the Haunted to the Graveyard as cost, then tributes itself to Fusion Summon Fallen Angel of the Golden Land. Call of the Forgotten Sets two more copies of Call of the Haunted from the Deck before the turn closes on an Xyz Summon of The Undying Legion — leaving a Fusion monster, a Rank 7 boss, a live Field Spell, and a fresh trap line all in play.

comboData.title: Fiendsmith Engraver One-Card: Zero King Machinex into Zeus Ragnarok and Deus Machinex
comboData.description: A one-card line from Fiendsmith Engraver. The Fiendsmith engine makes Fiendsmith's Lacrima and D/D/D Wave High King Caesar, which searches Dark Contract with the Gate when it leaves the field. From there the D/D half takes over: Zero Doom Queen Machinex places Dark Contract with the Zero King, Solomon and Marksman King Tell build Abyss King Gilgamesh, and Necro Slime and Alfred make Flame King Genghis. Orthros destroys the Zero King to bring Machinex back from the Extra Deck, and Zeus Ragnarok gives you a second Pendulum Summon. End board: Zeus Ragnarok, Deviser King Deus Machinex, Wave High King Caesar with 2 materials and Cursed King Siegfried, with Count Surveyor and Savant Thomas as Pendulum Scales, Dark Contract with the Gate, and a Set Dark Contract with the Eternal Darkness. TCG note: the line runs through Spright Elf, which is Forbidden in the TCG, and uses the one copy of Fiendsmith's Lacrima that the Limited list allows. Starting hand: Fiendsmith Engraver.

comboData.title: Endymion Full Combo Line (Advanced)
comboData.description: Advanced full combo line weaving together the Magistus, Spellbook, Witchcrafter, Sky Striker, and Mythical Beast engines. Not recommended for beginners — requires precise sequencing across 200+ steps. This is a specific draw loop variant of the deck, distinct from the standard Endymion line (which ends on multiple negates via Servant → Electrumite → Selene). The core of the draw loop: Royal Magical Library accumulates spell counters from each spell activation and cashes them in for free draws, while Wonder Wand draws 2 by sending itself and its equipped monster to the GY, and Pot of Avarice recycles monsters back into the deck for another two draws — each cycle fuelling the next until you have enough resources to establish the full end board with multiple Endymion bounce negates and set backrow.

comboData.title: 1-Card Foolish Burial (1 Discard) — Liger Dancer & I:P
comboData.description: A core 1-card starter line opening with Foolish Burial and 1 discard cost. Sends Lunalight Yellow Marten to search Lunalight Masquerade, triggering Silver Hound in the Graveyard to summon Gold Leo and Kaleido Chick. Summons Lunalight Perfume Dancer to search Luna Light Perfume, links into Cross-Sheep, and overlays Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Tiger King to search Fire Formation - Tenki. Places Lunalight Wolf in the Pendulum Scale to Miracle Fusion summon the untargetable Lunalight Liger Dancer alongside I:P Masquerena for disruption. Heads-up: this line uses Cross-Sheep, which is Forbidden in the TCG, so it isn't legal at TCG events as shown.

comboData.title: Endymion Magistus into the Full Fairy Tail Package
comboData.description: A hybrid line that builds the Magistus core off Spell Power Mastery before pivoting into a complete Fairy Tail package. Spell Power Mastery opens Regulus, the Prince of Endymion, which lands Endymion Empire and Verre, the Maid of Endymion; Verre Magic - Lacrima of Light and Witchcrafter Genni fuel Zoroa, the Magistus of Flame. Artemis, the Magistus Moon Maiden becomes Borreload Savage Dragon, then Spenta and Endymion, the Crescent Magistus feed Magistus Chorozo, Summon Sorceress and Akashic Magician, closing the Magistus half on Zoroa, the Magistus Verethragna. From there Fairy Tail - Luna and Matchgiru make Fairy Tail - Wiccat under Fairy Tail Ball, loading Once Upon a Fairy Tail and Tails of the Fairy Tails for Teller of Fairy Tails, a revived Fairy Tail - Snow and a second Wiccat, with Snow banishing the spent Magistus pieces to reset Once Upon a Fairy Tail. Heads-up: this line uses Borreload Savage Dragon, which is Forbidden in the TCG (as of 5 October 2026), so it isn't legal at TCG events as shown.

comboData.title: Twin Dragon Loop into Herald of Mirage Lights
comboData.description:
Continuing the Angwitch opening: Mace revives itself from the Graveyard, mills again, and fuels a second Mementotlan Fusion — bringing back Mementomictlan Tecuhtlica – Creation King straight out of the GY.

Tecuhtlica's on-summon mill revives Ghattic (who retrieves Shleepy) and banishes itself to activate the Mementomictlan field spell. Shleepy then special summons itself and fuels a second Fusion into Mementotlan Twin Dragon.

Twin Dragon's own Graveyard trigger sets the field spell off a second time, reviving Goblin, Akihiron, and Shleepy and chaining through a banished Fusion and Goblin's revival effects.

The line closes by Link Summoning Herald of Mirage Lights, reviving Mementotlan-Horned Dragon and Mementoal Tecuhtlica – Combined Creation from the Graveyard, and setting Bone Party, Fusion, and Cranium Burst as backrow for next turn.

comboData.title: Memento into Fiendsmith Splash — Necroquip Princess, Ptolemy M7 & Double Desirae
comboData.description:
Same Angwitch-into-Twin Dragon Memento core, splashed into a full Fiendsmith package. After the Mementomictlan field spell revives Goblin, Akihiron, and Shleepy, Link Summon Moon of the Closed Heaven into Fiendsmith's Requiem, then tribute Requiem to Special Summon Lacrima the Crimson Tears and mill a Fiendsmith Engraver.

Requiem's Graveyard effect fuels a Fusion Summon of Necroquip Princess. The Engraver chain keeps going into an Xyz Summon of Constellar Ptolemy M7, a Fiendsmith's Tract that searches Fabled Lurrie, and a Link Summon of Fiendsmith's Sequence that Fusion Summons Fiendsmith's Desirae.

Sequence and Desirae are sent together to Link Summon Cross-Sheep alongside a revived Mementoal Tecuhtlica – Combined Creation. Cross-Sheep chains into Lacrima once more to Link Summon A Bao A Qu, the Lightless Shadow.

A Bao A Qu mills Bone Party and banishes itself to Fusion Summon a second Fiendsmith's Desirae. The turn ends with Fusion and Cranium Burst set, plus an active Mementomictlan field spell, for a commanding board-and-backrow presence. Heads-up: this line uses Moon of the Closed Heaven, which is Forbidden in the TCG (as of 5 October 2026), so it isn't legal at TCG events as shown.

comboData.description: The Angwitch opening taken into a K9 package. comboData.title: Kale's Toon Synchro/Link Bridge into Red-Eyes Toon Dragon
comboData.description: A go-first line built on the Jet Synchron / Crystron Halqifibrax engine, bridging through Linkuriboh, Linkross, and Barricadeborg Blocker into Mecha Phantom Beast Auroradon. Auroradon floods the field with Deskbot 001 copies and Mecha Phantom Beast O-Lion to Synchro Summon Accel Synchron, then bridges further into Borreload Savage Dragon and Herald of the Arc Light. Toon Kingdom closes out the turn, banishing Toon Mermaid, Toon Dark Magician, and a hand monster to Special Summon Red-Eyes Toon Dragon. Heads-up: this line uses Crystron Halqifibrax, Linkross, Mecha Phantom Beast Auroradon, Borreload Savage Dragon and Herald of the Arc Light, which are Forbidden in the TCG (as of 5 October 2026), so it isn't legal at TCG events as shown.
